meta.title: Go
meta.description: Ticket orchestration, event intake, Worker supervision, and approvals.

panel.title: Go
panel.subtitle: An operational view of tasks, sessions, and approvals
panel.empty: No records yet. Connected sources will appear here.
panel.threadCountsHelp: Message count is the number of persisted Triggers, not a session transcript count. Last inbound message is the source's last incoming event time.
panel.pausedReadonlyHelp: Pause switches display source status only and are disabled. No source setting can be changed here.
panel.watchdogHelp: Up to 20 recorded decisions. Stall time is observed time since last progress, not the configured threshold. Missing metrics remain unknown.
panel.webAuthRequired: The DSH Web session is not authenticated. Reopen this GUI using the authenticated URL printed by DSH, then retry. Do not use a bare localhost URL.
panel.requestTimeout: The request timed out after 15 seconds.
panel.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response.
panel.placeholder: This page is available for viewing; detailed controls will be added in a later release.
panel.wDocumentConfigHint: Configure sources in plugin settings. Reads are manual; this view does not edit configuration or monitor documents.
panel.wDocumentReadUncertain: Read outcome is uncertain. It may still be running. View local snapshots to check; no automatic retry was made.
panel.wDocumentListPartial: More local candidates are available; the loaded list is not complete.
panel.wDocumentSnapshotWarning: A recorded snapshot does not prove the document is unchanged now.
panel.wDocumentStrikeUnknown: Strike status unknown — verify original sheet
panel.wDocumentUnknownReviewWarning: The source cannot determine strike formatting. Open the configured official sheet to verify this item and review all screenshots here. Attest only if the task text is not struck through. This is your attestation, not a machine determination or execution authorization.
panel.wDocumentOfficialUnavailable: The official sheet link is unavailable; manual verification cannot be submitted.
panel.wDocumentVerifyOriginalNotStruck: I opened the original sheet, confirmed this task text is not struck through, and reviewed all available screenshots here.
panel.wDocumentConfirmNotStruck: Confirm original is not struck; review plan only
panel.wDocumentReviewSaved: Manual attestation recorded. Choose Prepare review-plan draft next. Nothing was sent or authorized for execution.
panel.wDocumentReviewUncertain: Manual verification outcome is uncertain. Check local snapshots; no automatic retry or instruction send occurred.
panel.wDocumentNoImages: This snapshot has no screenshots. Review the source text.
panel.wDocumentImagesFailed: Evidence screenshot could not be loaded. Plan generation remains blocked.
panel.wDocumentImageNotLoaded: Screenshot has not been loaded or viewed.
panel.wDocumentReviewed: I have reviewed the source text and displayed screenshots.
panel.wDocumentReviewHint: This checkbox records your acknowledgement, not machine proof that evidence was understood. Known struck task-bearing cells stay blocked. Unknown formatting needs the explicit original-sheet verification above when the source permits it.
panel.wDocumentPlanOnly: Generate a plan only, not execution. Send the draft explicitly, then review the complete plan before confirming.
panel.wDocumentPlanDraft: Review-plan instruction prepared. Nothing was sent or authorized.
panel.wDocumentDraftOrigin: Selected untrusted document snapshot · plan only
panel.wImageDraftHint: No project selection required. Pick or paste PNGs here, preview locally, then upload explicitly. Navigation preserves this component's original draft without changing text or send targets; a page reload may lose it.
panel.wImageCapabilityBlocked: Original-image understanding and target delivery remain blocked: verified image capability/outbound authorization is missing, SA_EXECUTION_BOUNDARY_UNVERIFIED. Upload, preview, and binding prove neither model viewing nor delivery.
panel.wImageFormatLimit: Up to 5 images, 8 MiB each, 8 million pixels, 8192 per side. Only 8-bit non-interlaced PNG; JPEG, GIF, APNG, palette and other formats are blocked, not converted. Host validation still applies.
panel.wImageLimit: At most 5 images per draft. Remove or reconcile existing images first.
panel.wImageUnsupported: Image format, dimensions, or bytes are unsupported. No conversion or upload occurred. Supply 8-bit non-interlaced PNG.
panel.wImageReadFailed: A trusted image list was not obtained. Prior state is retained. Reconcile manually; no automatic retry.
panel.wImageUploadUnknown: Upload is unconfirmed; the Host may have saved it. Read the list first or explicitly retry the same upload ID and bytes. No new ID or automatic resend.
panel.wImageChangeUnknown: Binding or release is unconfirmed. Read the Host list to reconcile; no automatic repetition.
panel.wImageOriginalFailed: Host original bytes or digest could not be verified. No verified-original claim is made. Refresh scope or reconcile the list.
panel.wImageChooseTarget: Use this located target for image binding
panel.wImageBindingOnly: Bind this image draft only: no image delivery, activation, or approval reuse. Host revalidates scope and fact versions.
panel.wImageNoTarget: No binding target selected. Locate a handling conversation, then explicitly use it for image binding. Browsing projects never changes this target.
panel.wImagePreviewOnly: Browser preview only, not evidence of model viewing, understanding, or authorization.
panel.wImageOriginalVerified: Host original bytes passed SHA-256 verification. This does not prove model viewing.
panel.wImageNoPreview: No valid preview. Fetch the Host original under current scope.
panel.wImageStale: Scope or epoch changed. Preview and raw-byte cache were invalidated. Old binding is blocked; reconcile and choose the target again.
panel.wImageBind: Bind to selected target (do not send)
panel.wImageReleaseHint: Release only prevents future use. Bytes may remain; third-party retroactive erasure is not guaranteed. Reconcile uncertain outcomes first.
panel.wLocateHint: The locate stage first reads your natural-language request, then the bounded current-Host fact chain verifies the target. The model never owns the target and never executes, sends or rewrites your draft. No match creates no Worker.
panel.wLocateOnly: Verify location only: no execution, send, draft change, or send-target change. Execution safety remains blocked.
panel.wLocatePlaceholder: Text from a recorded goal or conversation title
panel.wLocateLocated: Unique handling conversation verified · not executed
panel.wLocateClarify: Choose a candidate and recheck current scope
panel.wLocateNoMatch: No match in searched scope; no conversation or Worker created
panel.wLocatePartial: Search coverage is incomplete. Candidates are for inspection, not proof of unique location.
panel.wLocateMatchUnavailable: No distinguishing work excerpt is available. A shared title does not establish the target.
panel.wLocateChanged: Scope changed; old candidates cannot be used. Verify again manually. No automatic retry was made.
panel.wLocateFailed: Location is unconfirmed. Verify again manually. No send, execution, or automatic retry occurred.
panel.wSessionActionBoundary: Only check this text action and persist minimal blocked control metadata. Production execution isolation is unverified and remains blocked. Nothing is sent, stopped, or approved; this does not complete R1.
panel.wSessionActionTextHint: Enter your direct request for this interaction. Location keywords, old chats, and the main draft are never copied here. Text stays in this component; the Host saves only a digest and binding metadata. Navigation neither cancels a submitted check nor rebinds its target.
panel.wSessionActionText: Your direct text for this action
panel.wSessionActionNewDraft: Retain original action; start a new check draft
panel.wSessionActionClose: Permanently seal original action ID (no resend)
panel.wSessionActionCloseHint: Explicitly ask the Host to permanently fence the original ID, not resend, stop, or cancel it. Closure is possible only without an existing action record; otherwise the Host returns the original state. A 404 never closes it automatically.
panel.wSessionActionClosed: Host permanently sealed the original action ID and guarantees this ID cannot be dispatched again. This does not prove historical execution or completion. A new draft requires another explicit click; nothing is automatically sent.
panel.wSessionActionClosureBinding: The closure did not verify the original target binding (bindingVerified=false). It is neither current-target authority nor completion evidence.
panel.wSessionActionCloseUnknown: No exact closure receipt was obtained. The original ID remains unknown and new actions are blocked. Check status only, or explicitly request closure of the same ID again; the action is never resent.
panel.wSessionActionOldUnknown: The old-epoch action receipt is unknown. No recovery entry is available in this epoch; new actions remain blocked. Cross-epoch closure or replacement IDs cannot bypass it.
panel.wSessionActionPending: Waiting for an exact original-action receipt; unconfirmed
panel.wSessionActionRecorded: Host durably recorded the check; not sent or executed; reconciliation remains necessary
panel.wSessionActionBlocked: Host durably recorded a block; not sent, executed, or completed
panel.wSessionActionUnknown: Original receipt is unknown; it may be recorded. Check status, or explicitly request original-ID closure when no normal receipt was obtained. No automatic resend or replacement IDs.
panel.wSessionActionAccepted: Target durable acceptance evidence only. Starting, execution, completion, and human reading remain unknown. Production execution isolation remains blocked.
panel.wSessionActionNotFound: Original action not found (404). This does not prove it was never delivered or recorded. Retain the original text and IDs; check status only.
panel.wSessionActionUnavailable: Could not prepare the check; no Host request was made. Original text is retained.
panel.wSessionActionUnresolved: Another original action has an unresolved receipt. A new target or ID cannot bypass it. Inspect retained actions and check status only.
panel.wSessionActionEvidence: View original text and exact action evidence
panel.wSessionActionRetainedHint: Old actions are read-only, never applied to the current target. An unsubmitted draft is editable only after locating the exact same epoch, project, conversation, and scope / fact revisions. Local text does not survive component unmount.
panel.wSessionActionOldEpoch: This evidence belongs to an old epoch, not the current scope. Cross-epoch status queries and resubmission are disabled here.
panel.wSessionActionOriginalText: Original action text (retained in this component only)
panel.wScopeEntryHint: Choose a project, including empty projects, then inspect only its included or excluded conversations. Browsing never changes the send target.
panel.wScopeDefault: Current Host only. New projects and ordinary conversations are included by default. Project exclusions override conversation restoration; individual exclusions survive project restoration.
panel.wScopeExcludeWarning: Exclusion revokes subsequent management; it does not stop accepted work or retract data already sent. Handle stopping separately in the original conversation.
panel.wScopeRestoreWarning: Restoration does not activate or replay work, keeps individual conversation exclusions, and does not reuse old approvals.
panel.wScopeReadFailed: Could not read management scope. Retained snapshots may be stale. Refresh manually; no automatic retry was made.
panel.wScopeChanged: Scope or project membership changed. Return to refresh the project list, then review again. No automatic retry was made.
panel.wScopeSaveFailed: An exact save receipt was not obtained; the outcome is unconfirmed. Refresh manually before acting again. No automatic retry was made.
panel.wScopeMutationPending: Scope change is awaiting a Host receipt. Navigation does not cancel the submitted request.
panel.wScopeMutationConfirmed: The original scope operation has an exact receipt for the target below only, not for the current page or stopping work.
panel.wScopeMutationUnknown: The original scope operation is unconfirmed. The Host may have saved it. No automatic replay occurred.
panel.wScopeMutationOldEpoch: This operation belongs to an older conversation scope and does not apply to this page; original epoch
panel.wScopeProjectNotFound: The previously loaded project window was refreshed without finding the original project. Automatic lookup stopped; verify the catalog manually.
panel.wScopeExcluded: Host confirmed exclusion: subsequent management is revoked. Accepted work was not stopped.
panel.wScopeRestored: Host confirmed project restoration: no activation or replay; individual conversation exclusions remain.
panel.wScopeSessionRestored: Host confirmed subsequent management for this conversation. No activation or replay; other conversation exclusions remain.
panel.wScopePartial: Scope information is partial. Known records do not cover every project or conversation.
panel.wScopeNotLoaded: No snapshot for this level yet. Refresh to read it.
panel.wScopeUnknownBlocked: Membership is unverified: no location, work-content read, or restoration. Refresh to verify Host membership.
panel.wScopeParentExcluded: This project is excluded. A child cannot be restored alone. Return to the project list to restore the project; individual conversation exclusions remain.
panel.wScopeNoProjects: No available projects or ordinary-conversation membership groups on this Host.
panel.wScopeNoIncluded: No ordinary conversations are included in this project.
panel.wScopeNoExcluded: No ordinary conversations are excluded in this project.
panel.wProjectPreviewHint: Preview of returned conversations, grouped by project.
panel.wProjectLoadedHint: Grouped by DSH project membership; more pages may contain additional projects or conversations.
panel.wWorkPartialShort: Some conversations are unavailable; showing known records.
panel.wWorkUnavailableShort: Conversation work is unavailable. Check or retry in Sources.
panel.wWorkEmptyShort: No ordinary conversations are included in this scope.
panel.wWorkDecisionsUnknown: Review items have not fully synced.
panel.wWorkFilterHint: Try another keyword or clear the filters.
panel.wWorkScopePending: The reporting scope is unconfirmed. Refresh to verify.
panel.wWorkNoTasks: No tasks assigned to the coordinator yet
panel.wWorkStartHint: Describe your goal to prepare a plan for review.
panel.wChatIntro: What would you like to do?
panel.wChatIntroHint: Describe a goal or ask a question. Review the plan before confirming.
panel.wSessionWorkLedgerNoDecision: No pending decisions for registered tasks
panel.wSessionWorkReadonly: Observe existing work only: no takeover, activation, or task creation. An idle conversation does not mean completed work.
panel.wSessionWorkDefault: Ordinary conversations on this Host are included by default, including new ones. Exclusions persist and can be restored without changing the original conversation.
panel.wSessionWorkPartial: Some conversation facts are unavailable. Known records below do not cover all work.
panel.wSessionWorkUnavailable: Conversation work is unavailable. This does not establish that there is no work.
panel.wSessionWorkCoverageReady: Current-Host ordinary conversations included by default · board counts registered tasks only
panel.wSessionWorkCoveragePartial: Current-Host conversation work partially available · board counts registered tasks only
panel.wSessionWorkCoverageUnavailable: Current-Host conversation work unavailable · board counts registered tasks only
panel.wSessionWorkLedgerHint: No pending decisions for registered tasks here. Known work in other conversations is shown separately and is not added to board counts.
panel.wSessionWorkEmpty: No included ordinary conversations in the current scope; this does not mean there is no other work.
panel.wSessionWorkAnswerAtSource: Question shown only; no answer or approval can be sent here. Handle it in the original conversation.
panel.wSessionWorkExcludedHint: These conversations are hidden from work coverage and can be restored; the original conversations are not stopped or deleted.
panel.wSessionWorkNoExcluded: No conversations have been manually excluded.
panel.wSessionWorkReadFailed: Could not refresh conversation work. Retained records may be stale; retry to check.
panel.wSessionWorkChanged: Conversation coverage changed. Refresh before trying again; no automatic retry was made.
panel.wSessionWorkSaveFailed: Coverage change is not confirmed. Refresh to verify before trying again; no conversation was controlled.
panel.wSessionWorkExcluded: Exclusion preference saved. The original conversation is unchanged.
panel.wSessionWorkRestored: Restored to read-only coverage. The original conversation was not activated.
panel.wBriefMissing: No task brief is available. Scope cannot be reviewed.
panel.wRequestFailed: Request failed. Its outcome may be unknown; refresh before retrying an action.
panel.wWebAuthRequired: The DSH Web session is not authenticated. Reopen this GUI using the authenticated URL printed by DSH, then retry. Do not use a bare localhost URL.
panel.wBoardResync: The board changed. Refreshing; shown cards may be out of date.
panel.wFilterRefreshing: Updating filters. Shown cards and counts may still belong to the previous filter.
panel.wDecisionConflict: The item changed or is no longer actionable. Refresh and review it again.
panel.wEpochChanged: The conversation changed. Your previous draft is kept separately; review the current conversation before sending.
panel.wAcceptedNotice: Request accepted. This does not mean it was executed or completed.
panel.wUnknownNotice: Receipt not confirmed. Check status or retry the same request; do not send a duplicate.
panel.wTextLimit: Use at most 16,384 UTF-8 bytes and remove any null characters.
panel.wSecureIdUnavailable: A secure request ID could not be created. Nothing was sent.
panel.wNotFoundNotice: No receipt was found for this request. Retry the same request or return to the saved draft.
panel.wCancelUnknownHint: Cancel only this unconfirmed routing request. A late chat message may still appear, but it must not create a task or reach a Worker. This does not stop model generation or an accepted task. The server will refuse if admission is already proven.
panel.wRequestCanceled: Uncertain routing request canceled. Your draft is preserved; no task-stop claim is made.
panel.wRecreateTask: Create a new task from this request
panel.wResolveDraftFirst: Resolve the pending request or save/clear the current draft first. It has not been overwritten.
panel.wRevisionHint: Revise this plan's goal and first action. Its project, write scope and checks stay unchanged. This creates a new fingerprint for review; it does not approve or execute the plan.
panel.wHomeRelativeScope: Project identity: ~ is this Host owner's home directory; the full remaining project path is shown. This does not grant execution permission.
panel.wScopeHidden: This plan is redacted, incomplete, or not reviewable. Its full scope cannot be verified, so approval is disabled.
panel.wExpiredPlan: This plan has expired and cannot be approved. Request a fresh plan and review its scope again.
panel.wStoppedNotice: The server reports this task has ended. This is not a completion claim.
panel.wDecisionSaved: Decision recorded. This does not confirm execution or completion.
panel.wResolveRequestFirst: Resolve the pending request and switch to the current draft before adding task input.
panel.wCannotApprove: Approval requires an unexpired pending item, permission, a review fingerprint, and fully reviewable impact. Redacted or incomplete scope cannot be approved.
panel.wAdmissionHint: Review the goal, scope, allowed writes, and acceptance checks. Approval records consent to this plan; it does not bypass execution safety gates.
panel.wApprovalWindow: Pending approvals only. Load more to see the remaining items; task history may include earlier decisions.
panel.wReadonly: Read-only. Settings and source switches cannot be changed here. Missing values remain unknown.
panel.wBoundaryBody: Production Worker execution is disabled because L1/L2 safety has not been verified. Plans, receipts, and recorded states are not independent proof of execution or completion.
panel.wModelUnavailable: The planning model is unavailable. Existing records remain viewable; no new model response is guaranteed.
panel.wSendUnavailable: Sending is unavailable. Existing records remain viewable.
panel.wStaleData: Shown data may be out of date.
panel.wStorageUnavailable: This tab could not save the draft or pending request. Keep a copy before leaving; reload recovery is not guaranteed.
panel.wReviewPlanHint: Review scope, steps and checks before confirming.
panel.wRecordsStale: Update failed. Keeping the previous records below.
panel.wDescribeOutcome: Only coordinator-registered work appears here. Other conversations are not included yet.
panel.wNothingToDecide: No pending decisions for registered tasks
panel.wProgressOnBoard: Progress for registered tasks is on the board. Other conversations are not included yet.
panel.wPlanningSteps: Describe → review the plan · execution is off
panel.wInputForPlan: For example: investigate login timeouts; propose a plan first…
panel.wInputForQuestion: What would you like to know?
panel.wInputForTask: Add requirements or answer the task question…
panel.wPlanChanged: This plan changed or ended. Go back for the latest record.
panel.wReplyKeepsDraft: Resolve the existing draft or task target first. Your input will not be overwritten.
panel.wReplyNotDecision: Original reply for communication only; not task state or operation approval.
panel.wRepliesUnavailable: Could not sync coordinator replies. Open dialogue history to retry.
panel.wBriefingUnavailable: The running service does not provide a brief yet. Reload the plugin service; history remains available.
panel.wBriefingScope: All task records, independent of board filters
panel.wBriefingRecordHint: Recorded tasks only, not proof of execution. Acceptance-test records keep their original names, not business outcomes.
panel.wPlanApprovedBlocked: Confirmed plan · task not created yet
panel.wNoStructuredDecisions: No pending decisions in the ledger. Check the latest reply or dialogue history for coordinator questions.
panel.wAllTasksUnfiltered: Filters cleared. Continue viewing coordinator-registered tasks; other conversations are not included.
panel.wNoResultSummary: No structured result summary. Inspect the details.
panel.wHistoryRecordHint: Original dialogue and notices, including historical acceptance records. Message text or delivery stage does not prove task completion.
panel.wQuestionsOnBoard: Inspect questions and state conflicts on the task board. Approval is not a substitute for answering.
panel.wArchiveReadonly: Archived conversation: read-only. Switch to the current conversation to send.
panel.wHistoryUnavailable: Conversation history is unavailable. Retry to load it.
panel.wStartHere: Start with a message or task plan
panel.wStartHint: Ask a question or describe a task. Review its plan before approval. Production Worker execution is currently disabled.
panel.wOldDraftHint: This draft belongs to a previous conversation and cannot be sent here. Copy any text you need, then switch to the current draft. Pending requests stay with their original conversation.
panel.wInputPlaceholder: Ask a question or describe a task to plan…
panel.wInputHelp: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line. Sending does not start a production Worker.
panel.wPendingRequest: This request has no confirmed final receipt. Check status or retry the same request before sending anything else.
panel.wDraftRetained: Draft retained. Review the request status before sending it as a new request.
panel.wCoveragePendingHint: Showing returned records; their coverage has not been confirmed.
panel.wServerTotal: Registered tasks in this column, including unloaded records; other conversations excluded
panel.wServerTotalUnknownScope: Returned column total; coverage not confirmed
panel.wEmptyColumn: No registered tasks in this column.
panel.wEmptyFilteredColumn: No registered tasks match this filter.
panel.wEmptyColumnUnknownScope: This column returned 0 records; coverage not confirmed.
panel.wNoLoadedTasks: No task records on this page despite a nonzero total. Refresh to retry.
panel.wStateConflict: Task records disagree. The displayed state is uncertain; refresh and inspect the details.
panel.wExecutionBlocked: Worker execution is blocked; no new work is started here.
panel.wRecordedResultOnly: Task ledger state · report claims below
panel.wChecksIncomplete: Check records are incomplete or conflicting. Inspect the original report.
panel.wNoHumanRequestReported: This report requests no human input.
panel.wApprovalStillPending: Approval is still pending. The report does not replace your decision.
panel.wNoWorkReported: No completed items recorded in this report.
panel.wSummaryUnavailable: No reliable structured record. Inspect the original report.
panel.wNoCurrentReport: No report for this attempt. An older report cannot stand in for the current result.
panel.wLatestAttemptUnknown: The current attempt is uncertain. Inspect execution records.
panel.wCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the ID and copy it manually.
panel.wTaskTimelineHint: Recorded task events, not the Worker's full conversation or tool log.
panel.wResultsHint: Recorded attempts and reports only. A report alone does not prove acceptance checks passed or work was completed.
panel.wNoReadAck: Delivery status does not prove the recipient read or accepted the result.
panel.wStopConfirm: Request this task to stop? It may take time to end. Already completed side effects are not undone.
panel.wApproveConfirm: Approve the exact plan or impact shown? Review its scope first. Approval does not bypass safety gates or confirm execution.
panel.wRejectConfirm: Reject this plan or approval? Rejection does not undo any earlier actions.
panel.wGoLocalIntro: Read one explicit file inside a Host-authorized directory only. Save configuration, then scan and review manually; source content is never executed automatically.
panel.wGoNoRoots: No authorized directories. Ask a Host administrator to authorize one first; arbitrary absolute paths cannot be entered here.
panel.wGoPath: Relative file path inside the directory
panel.wGoSupportBody: Markdown, TXT, and CSV are supported; CSV requires a unique, nonempty ID column. Office, PDF, and ordinary Tencent documents / spreadsheets are unsupported. WeCom documents use a separate entry. Markdown previews only validated original PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP images inside the authorized directory.
panel.wGoFailed: Request failed. Refresh to verify; no automatic retry occurred.
panel.wGoInvalid: The Host receipt is missing or mismatched; success is not confirmed.
panel.wGoMutationClose: Seal an unrecorded ID; do not repeat
panel.wGoMutationClosed: The Host permanently sealed the original ID. Refresh and explicitly load the latest configuration before editing again.
panel.wGoMutationRejected: The Host explicitly rejected the request. The original request and rejection evidence are retained; no successful save is claimed.
panel.wGoMutationRecorded: The Host recorded the original request, but its outcome is not yet known. Editing stays locked; only a status check is allowed.
panel.wGoUnknownMutation: The previous change has an unknown outcome. Its original request is retained and must not be changed or resubmitted. Check the original request status.
panel.wGoRaw: Original text (external untrusted material; plain text only)
panel.wGoImageUnseen: Original image has not been displayed successfully
panel.wGoImageLoaded: Original image displayed locally (not proof of model viewing)
panel.wGoImageBlocked: Original image cannot be displayed; review cannot be confirmed
panel.wGoImageFailed: Original image validation or display failed
panel.wGoReviewed: I reviewed the selected original text and displayed originals; create an independent draft only
panel.wGoRetryClaim: Check draft creation using the original requestId
panel.wGoClaimUnknown: Draft creation has an unknown outcome. No automatic resend or new ID; only an explicit check with the original request is allowed.
panel.wGoResetForm: Load latest Host configuration (replace current form)
panel.wGoDraftOnly: Local independent draft material only: no execution authorization, no insertion into the main composer, and no send. Navigation will not overwrite other drafts.
panel.wGoPlanDraft: Hand off with provenance (reviewable plan only)
panel.wGoPlanDraftImagesBlocked: The image-bearing planning bridge is not supported yet; images will not be omitted.
panel.wGoPlanDraftOccupied: The main chat has a draft or the view changed. The original draft is retained.
panel.wGoPlanDraftReady: A reviewable plan draft was placed in the main chat, not sent or authorized for execution. The independent original is retained.
panel.wGoPlanDraftUnavailable: The main chat has no reviewable-plan entry point. The independent draft is retained.
panel.wGoPlanDraftInvalid: Provenance receipt is missing or mismatched. Nothing was inserted; the original is retained for a manual retry.
panel.wGoPlanDraftFailed: Provenance lookup failed. Nothing was inserted; the original is retained for a manual retry.
panel.wGoPlanDraftIntro: Claiming only retains an independent draft: no execution authorization, composer insertion, or send. An explicit accepted handoff inserts a reviewable plan draft; review and send remain separate. The original is always retained.
panel.wGoOldEpoch: Old-workspace draft retained read-only; old authorization cannot be reused.
panel.wGoNoItems: This snapshot has no selectable items.
panel.wGoStale: Snapshot is stale or blocked. Go back and scan again.
panel.wGoModelsIntro: Configure future stage routes only; no real model call or test is run. Existing conversations retain their original models; overriding existing conversations is unsupported.
panel.wGoUnsaved: Edits are not saved and are not the effective route.
panel.wGoNoCatalog: The Host supplied no selectable model catalog; new configuration cannot be saved.
panel.wGoInspectPending: Verifying reasoning efforts for the selected model. Saving is disabled until verification finishes.
panel.wGoInspectFailed: Selected model metadata could not be verified. Refresh to check again; no model was run.
panel.wGoDecisionBoundary: A business answer is not operation approval. Answers are checked and recorded only, never sent; the production execution gate remains closed.
panel.wGoDecisionLocate: Explicitly locate a currently managed conversation before reading its original questions.
panel.wGoDecisionFailed: The outcome is unconfirmed. Check the original operation status manually; no automatic retry or redelivery will occur.
panel.wGoDecisionChanged: The target or question revision changed. Read again; the old draft is retained as evidence only and cannot answer the current question.
panel.wGoDecisionEmpty: The current projection has no active questions. This does not prove that every question type is covered.
panel.wGoDecisionPartial: The question projection is incomplete; answers cannot be checked.
panel.wGoDecisionCold: This conversation has no complete live projection. Original questions are shown, but answers cannot be checked here.
panel.wGoDecisionOpen: This question is still in its original waterfall and must be handled in the original conversation; it cannot be answered here.
panel.wGoDecisionBlocked: Production answer delivery is unverified. Answer checks retain only genuine blocked receipts.
panel.wGoDecisionDetails: View original questions and answer draft
panel.wGoDecisionCustom: Explain in your own words / another approach
panel.wGoDecisionCancelConditions: Cancel conditions (keep draft; omit hidden text)
panel.wGoDecisionChoose: For each question, choose a suggestion, explain in your own words, or explicitly skip.
panel.wGoDecisionUnknown: The receipt is unconfirmed. The original request and answers are retained. Only the same action may be checked; no new ID or resend.
panel.wGoDecisionOldEpoch: This unresolved operation belongs to an old epoch and cannot be restored or queried here. Verify the original conversation manually.
panel.wGoDecisionAccepted: Target durable acceptance confirmed; not completion, reading, or approval
panel.wGoDecisionNewDraft: Explicitly start an empty answer draft (retain original receipt)
panel.wGoDecisionNoCopy: The new draft inherits no old answers or approvals. Choose and check again.
panel.wGoDecisionUnresolved: An original operation still has an unresolved outcome. Another answer cannot be created or checked.
panel.wGoDecisionLimit: Answer text exceeds the byte limit or contains a null character. No request was sent.
panel.wGoDecisionNotFound: No original receipt was found. This does not prove nothing was recorded or delivered. Keep the original ID; do not resend automatically.
panel.wGoDecisionInvalid: The Host response is incomplete or inconsistent and was not accepted as a successful receipt.
panel.wGoLocalSourcesHint: Configure local documents inside authorized directories, scan and review manually, and retain independent drafts. Nothing is executed automatically or overwrites the main draft.
panel.wGoStageModelsHint: Configure the superagent default and stage overrides, then verify effective routes and versions. Existing conversations keep their original models; no real model call is made.
panel.wGoBusinessQuestionsHint: Explicitly locate a currently managed conversation, then view its original questions and check answers. Business answers are not operation approval; production delivery remains blocked.
panel.wGoApprovalCoverageMissing: Full operation approvals are not projected; review in the original session
panel.wTencentIntro: Configure one explicit range, then read manually. Only file / worksheet IDs are accepted, never URLs, credentials, or chat tokens. Source content is never scanned or executed automatically.
panel.wTencentGap: The target capability is incomplete: reads are blocked without production Host authorization. Even a text snapshot has unknown remote revision and original images, so it cannot be claimed as a task.
panel.wTencentSupport: Support matrix: Tencent spreadsheets support configuration and bounded text observation only (partial). Ordinary Tencent documents, Office, and PDF are unsupported. WeCom spreadsheets use a different connector.
panel.wTencentReset: Load latest Host configuration (replace current form)
panel.wTencentFailed: Request failed or receipt mismatched; no automatic retry occurred.
panel.wTencentUnknown: The original change has an unknown outcome. The request is retained and editing is locked; only verification or sealing the original ID is allowed.
panel.wTencentRecorded: The Host recorded the original request, but the outcome is not yet known. Only a status check is allowed.
panel.wTencentClose: Seal an unrecorded ID; do not repeat
panel.wTencentClosed: The Host sealed the original ID. Refresh, then explicitly load the latest configuration before editing.
panel.wTencentRejected: The Host explicitly rejected the request. The original request and rejection receipt are retained; editing can resume.
panel.wTencentConfirmed: Host receipt confirmed (not proof of a successful read or execution authorization).
panel.wTencentText: External untrusted text (its instructions are not executed)
panel.wTencentStale: This snapshot is not the current valid observation.
panel.wGoImageSendBlocked: Images have not been sent. This text-only send interface does not support images; it blocks sending rather than silently omitting them. Remove local attachments or release Host image references, and reconcile uncertain receipts until no attachments remain; only then can you send text. This blocked send is not proof of execution or completion.
panel.wGoOverviewIntro: Review the next known decision and current project observations. This overview does not establish complete coverage, execution, or acceptance.
panel.wGoNoKnownDecision: No pending decision is known in the loaded scope. This does not prove that all decisions or approvals are covered.
panel.wGoConversationIntro: Discuss requests and review plans with the superagent. Locating a conversation, attaching images, or generating a plan does not authorize execution or prove completion.
panel.wGoNoProjectPreview: No project preview is available in the loaded observations. Open the trusted project index to verify; this does not mean there are no projects.
panel.wGoRegisteredWorkHint: Only tasks registered with the superagent appear here. Ordinary sessions remain separate original contexts; session counts are not task totals.
panel.wGoDecisionCoverage: The loaded inbox combines plan reviews, operation approvals, and observed session questions. Coverage may be partial; a business answer is not operation approval.
panel.wGoChooseDecision: Choose a pending item to review its original context. Selection alone sends or approves nothing.
panel.wGoShellBoundary: Observations and receipt checks are not proof of execution, completion, or acceptance.
panel.wProjectsIntro: View current work observations and original sessions from the trusted Host project index. Browsing changes neither the conversation draft nor the send target.
panel.wProjectsFailed: Read failed. Loaded content is only the previous observation and may be stale. No automatic retry occurred; explicitly refresh projects and scope.
panel.wProjectsChanged: The scope or project fact revision changed; old content is invalid. Refresh projects and scope.
panel.wProjectsInvalid: Host data is incomplete or inconsistent with this project. No content was displayed; refresh to verify.
panel.wProjectsPartial: Part of the scope remains unverified. Loaded content does not represent every project or all work.
panel.wProjectsEmpty: No projects are available to display in the currently loaded scope.
panel.wProjectsNotLoadedProject: This project is not in the loaded index. It may be on another page, deleted, or inaccessible; do not infer membership from its title.
panel.wProjectsUnknownProject: Project membership is unknown; reading work content is blocked. Refresh the trusted project index. Do not infer membership from a name or directory.
panel.wProjectsExcluded: This project is excluded; work content is neither read nor displayed. Exclusion does not stop the original session. Restore it in Settings → Management scope, then refresh to verify.
panel.wProjectsMissingProject: This session has no verified project reference. Return to the project index to verify membership. No cross-project content search or title matching occurs.
panel.wProjectsNotLoadedSession: This session is not in the loaded included pages. Load more or refresh to verify; it may also have moved, been excluded or deleted, or become inaccessible.
panel.wProjectsObservationIntro: These are current work observations with structured objectives, not additional Tickets. A session is not assumed to handle only one item forever. Session counts are not work-item totals.
panel.wProjectsObservationEmpty: No structured objective observations are available in the loaded sessions. This does not mean the project has no work. View session context or load more pages.
panel.wProjectsSessionIntro: Only actual original session contexts are listed here; they are not copied into extra work-item entities. Runtime state is not a business outcome.
panel.wProjectsSessionEmpty: The loaded pages contain no included original sessions.
panel.wProjectsNoObjective: This session has no trusted structured objective observation yet. Verify the original session context; do not invent a work item from its title.
panel.wProjectsSourceGap: The current API provides no trusted project-to-task-source association. Do not assign every source to this project or conclude that this project has no sources.
panel.wProjectsCurrentObservation: Current work observation (from original session structured facts)
panel.wProjectsDecision: Original session question observation (not operation approval)
panel.wProjectsMissingFact: No reliable fact is available yet
panel.wProjectsNoTimeline: Only the current fact snapshot is shown. No trusted event timeline is available; no history or completion evidence is invented.
panel.wProjectsApprovalGap: Approval coverage gap: general tool approvals and older blocking questions from ordinary sessions have no complete trusted projection. They cannot be approved or claimed fully handled here.
panel.wProjectsResultGap: Results have not been acceptance-verified; acceptanceVerified: false. A self-reported complete goal, completed steps, or idle state is not acceptance.
panel.wProjectsNoResult: No result facts are available yet; completion cannot be inferred.
panel.wProjectsRelationGap: Only Host project membership and original session references are available. There are no trusted source associations or extra work-item / subtask lineage; titles are not used to merge records.
panel.wProjectsInactive: This view is inactive; work content is neither read nor retained.
panel.wProjectsNoEpoch: The workspace is not ready; nothing is read yet.
panel.wGoDecisionClose: Seal the unconfirmed original record ID (do not stop the session)
panel.wGoDecisionCloseConfirm: Confirm again: seal only the original ID; do not deliver answers
panel.wGoDecisionCloseBoundary: Seal the original ID only when it has no record. This does not stop, cancel, or approve any operation. Retain the original questions, answers, and receipt evidence; do not replace the ID or check the answers again.
panel.wGoDecisionCloseUnknown: The closure receipt is unconfirmed. Retain the original ID and closure request; only manually checking the original operation status is allowed. The ID is not considered sealed.
panel.wGoDecisionClosed: Original record ID durably sealed; not delivered. This does not mean stopped, canceled, or approved.
panel.wDeliveryHint: The card applies only to the one exactly located conversation: check project, session, action, body and images. Nothing is sent or woken before confirmation; after confirmation only a durable “confirmed, pending delivery” receipt exists, and Dispatch requires your explicit click.
panel.wDeliveryNoTarget: First finish an exact location above and enter the action body. Browsing, canceling or switching views never rewrites the draft or send target.
panel.wDeliveryPrepared: Prepared for your confirmation; nothing is delivered before you confirm.
panel.wDeliveryUnknown: Delivery confirmation outcome unknown; only the original status may be queried. No automatic retry or delivery.
panel.wDeliveryBodySummary: Body summary (the full body stays in this component)
panel.wDeliveryTextRequired: Enter the body to deliver above first.
panel.wDeliveryContentChanged: Body or images changed; the previous confirmation is invalid. The draft is kept; prepare again.
panel.wDeliveryChanged: Target or content changed; the previous confirmation is invalid. The draft is kept; prepare again.
panel.wDeliveryConfirmUnknown: No confirmation receipt obtained; it may not be confirmed. Only the original status may be queried. No automatic retry or delivery.
panel.wDeliveryNotFound: Confirmation object not found (404); this does not mean it was delivered. No automatic retry.
panel.wDeliveryUnavailable: Could not prepare the confirmation object; nothing was delivered and the draft is kept.
panel.wDeliveryErrorUnknown: Confirmation status unknown; no automatic retry or delivery.
panel.wDeliveryCancelConfirmed: This confirmation was completed elsewhere and cannot be canceled. Query the original status; no automatic retry or delivery.
panel.wDeliveryConfirmedHint: You confirmed this content. Confirmation is not delivery, target acceptance, execution or completion; only the explicit Dispatch action sends one controlled delivery, and accepted means the target durably received it.
panel.wDeliveryConfirmHint: No delivery side effect exists before confirmation; after confirmation it remains “confirmed, pending delivery”.
panel.wDeliveryAcceptedHint: accepted only means the target has durable evidence of this message; it does not mean execution started, finished or the task completed, and it is never retried automatically.
panel.wDeliveryDispatchUnknown: Dispatch outcome unknown: it may or may not have been accepted. It is never resent under a new ID; only the original dispatch can be reconciled.
panel.wDeliveryDispatchBlocked: Dispatch blocked; no target side effect was produced.
panel.wDeliveryDispatchBlockedHint: The target cannot take a delivery right now (for example a cold session). This capability never wakes cold sessions and never retries automatically.
panel.wDeliveryDispatchChanged: The confirmed body, target or images changed, so dispatch was rejected. Nothing is resent automatically; prepare a fresh confirmation.
panel.wDeliveryTargetCold: Target conversation is offline (cold): no wake-up, no delivery, no retry. Cold wake-up is left to a later capability.
panel.wLocateIntentClarify: The request did not form a checkable project or work intent, or confidence was too low. Name the project or the work explicitly and verify again.
